net_transfers: not a printed table line (transfers in and out are printed as separate rows); the narrative prints a net figure only for individual new pension funds, rounded to NIS million, not captured
operating_profit: not printed; the segment note prints profit before tax (profit_before_tax) and the components management fees, selling and marketing, general and administrative expenses
investment_contracts / investment policies: not applicable, they are insurer products reported by Migdal Insurance, not by the managing company

notes: Source is the managing company's own report (מגדל מקפת קרנות פנסיה וקופות גמל בע"מ, wholly owned by Migdal Insurance), taken from the Migdal website; the listed parent's report was not used.

Text layer: the accessible PDFs drop digits or letters in some text extractors, so values were read with PDFium and every table row was cross-checked against word coordinates (pdfplumber); each 9-column row was checked to sum to its printed total column.

Fund-type table columns (fund_type): veteran = קרן פנסיה ותיקה מקיפה (Yozma); comprehensive = קרן פנסיה חדשה מקיפה (Makefet Ishit); general = קרן פנסיה חדשה כללית (Makefet Mashlima); personal_provident = קופ"ג לתגמולים ואישית לפיצויים; study_fund = קרן השתלמות; investment_provident = קופ"ג להשקעה; child_savings = קופ"ג להשקעה לחסכון ארוך טווח לילד; other_funds = אחר (central severance, sick pay, budget-pension participation funds); total = סה"כ printed total of all columns.

Segments: pension_veteran = veteran column; pension_new = comprehensive and general columns (printed as two columns, no subtotal in the fund-type table, nothing summed); provident = personal_provident, study_fund, investment_provident, child_savings, other_funds (IRA accounts included in the first two); total = the printed total column. Segment totals printed in the assets table (היקף הנכסים) are recorded with segment pension, pension_new, pension_veteran, provident and total.

Windows: Q1 reports print three months (window q); Q2 and Q3 reports print six / nine months from 1 January (ytd); the annual report prints the year (fy). Balances (members, aum) are instant at the period end.
